from tinycsv import parse
assert parse('') == []
assert parse('a,b') == [['a','b']]
assert parse('""') == [['']]
assert parse('a,b\n') == [['a','b']]

from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
print('decimal half-even, 0.125 @2:', Decimal('0.125').quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))
print('builtin round(2.5):', round(2.5), ' round(3.5):', round(3.5), ' round(0.125,2):', round(0.125, 2))
